name: Twister Body Control
description: Benchmarks how well an AI can operate a human body in MuJoCo to play Twister via position-controlled joint angles.

binding_vow.description: Control a 3D humanoid rig in a physics simulator using target joint angles (degrees). Phase 1: place one limb on a spinner-assigned colored circle. Phase 2: survive multiple turns while keeping locked limbs in place. Falls and slipped placements end the episode.

observation_space.description: { phase, command, target_circle, reach_vector, primary_joints, ik_suggestion, joints, joint_targets, end_effectors, mat, locked_limbs, turn, upright, torso, placement_error? }

action_space.description: { joint_targets?, delta?, max_delta?, follow_ik?, ik_blend?, use_ik? } — absolute angles in degrees, or use_ik for built-in whole-body reach

reward.description: Phase 1: 1.0 on valid placement while upright, partial credit by distance otherwise. Phase 2: +1.5 per completed turn, partial credit while attempting placement.
